name: MyFinMarkdown-bench
description: A benchmark for evaluating LLM performance on financial content presented or expected in Markdown format, measuring generation quality, factuality, and formatting adherence. It targets tasks like writing summaries, explanations, and structured financial notes in Markdown. Models are assessed primarily on human judgment of correctness and presentation.
reputation: Niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in finance-focused model evaluation.
